recommendation: Keep the audit as-is. Do not edit retired DSTU1 condition-status artifacts; future Condition clinical status value or unknown-use changes should go through the later clinicalStatus/terminology issue family or THO/UTG.
issue_request: Published/Persuasive DSTU1 Patient Care issue requesting an unknown code in the then-current Condition.status value set, with the same sort of cautionary commentary used for Observation.status.
initial_application: Git commit decee3cf22e612e7e175c200ef84d83381bb5182 explicitly applied the issue as SVN revision 4840 by adding unknown and last-resort wording to the old Condition spreadsheet source.
additional_context: Later final Patient Care issues renamed Condition.status to Condition.clinicalStatus, split clinical and verification status, moved terminology content to THO/UTG, added unknown for current clinicalStatus use, and updated the clinicalStatus short display to include unknown.
